patches.name: Custom icons mod
patches.description: Replaces 203 LINE drawables (tab bar, top bars, Chats and Friends headers, Settings rows and Home) with Microsoft Fluent icons. Colours follow LINE's light and dark themes. Account and brand logos stay unchanged.
